name: Lineup.ai (part of TimeForge)
oneLiner: AI sales, labor and menu-item forecasting with automated scheduling for restaurants, now part of TimeForge's labor management suite.
bestFor: Multi-location restaurant operators who want AI demand forecasting to drive schedules and prep, particularly those open to TimeForge's broader scheduling and labor platform.
features: AI sales forecasting by hour, day and week from POS history
External signals such as weather and local events in the forecast
Labor forecasting with staffing targets per shift and location
Menu-item forecasting to guide ordering and prep
Multi-location reporting on forecast and labor variance
Access to TimeForge's 15-minute forecasting and labor tools

pricing.text: Custom pricing; no vendor-published price found (a GetApp listing shows 'from $79/month', not confirmed by the vendor).

notes: ACQUIRED: TimeForge (labor management software, founded 1998) added Lineup.ai to its product suite in August 2024 (https://www.fsrmagazine.com/industry-news/timeforge-adds-lineup-ai-to-product-suite/ and https://hospitalitytech.com/timeforge-adds-lineupai-its-platform-ai-powered-forecasting-labor-solutions). Lineup.ai was previously built by Lineup, LLC, a subsidiary of 1848 Ventures. TimeForge said Lineup would remain available. No named customers and no 2025-2026 updates found (search budget ran out). Directory listings now show TimeForge as vendor and very small team size. Consider listing it as TimeForge (with Lineup.ai forecasting) instead. The '$79/month' figure is third-party only, so it was left out of the pricing text.
